acceptanceCriteria: The packet gains a per-host instruction load-set field for the hosts in integrations/compatibility.json, modelled as data with a cited host-doc source per rule.
Fixtures prove the CLAUDE.md-shadows-AGENTS.md case and the 32 KiB Codex truncation case.
Host rules that cannot be confirmed report UNKNOWN rather than a guessed load set.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner-requested gap analysis of Corvint against competing context tools, current standards and a trial on a local clone of MeVille (TypeScript, about 4,600 tracked files). Hosts resolve instruction files differently: Codex walks root to working directory, one file per directory (AGENTS.override.md > AGENTS.md > fallbacks) and stops at project_doc_max_bytes (32 KiB default); Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when no CLAUDE.md exists at or above the working directory, loads subdirectory files lazily and expands @imports (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory; learn.chatgpt.com agents-md). A packet can state, per host, the load set, files present but ignored, and truncation, so an agent and reviewer can see instructions the host will never show. Depends on nested-file admission.
title: context: report which instruction files each host would actually load for the subject
